title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents for follow-up regarding management of type 2 diabetes.

History of Present Illness
The patient has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus. Today's visit addresses ongoing management of the condition. The patient notes recent elevated blood glucose readings, indicative of hyperglycemia. Current management remains focused on adherence to diet and exercise. Review of diet suggests continued focus is needed to keep the type 2 diabetes mellitus in check.

Medication List
None. Management is diet controlled only.

Exam
Vitals are stable today. Physical exam is generally unremarkable.

Assessment
1. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Remains poorly controlled, evidenced by recent hyperglycemia. Management should continue to emphasize diet and exercise for this type 2 diabetes.

Plan
Continue current management plan emphasizing strict adherence to diet and exercise. Patient educated on signs and symptoms of hyperglycemia and when to seek further care. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Diabetes documented as poorly controlled, out of control, or with hyperglycemia is coded to diabetes with hyperglycemia.

distractors.why: Hyperglycemia is a complication with its own code.
